stages.name: ASSISTIVE_VISION
stages.identity: Assistive eyes and voice for blind/low-vision users
stages.implementation_boundary: The archived SensorBridge scaffold contains camera, voice, SceneState, IntentSpec, mock vision, GPT-S client, and TTS. This proves historical origin, not current product identity or pilot readiness.

stages.name: CHART_SEMANTIC_PIVOT
stages.identity: Market chart treated as a visual world; semantic filter applied to market structure
stages.implementation_boundary: The chart-as-visual-world framing establishes that semantic structure takes precedence over candle names. It does not establish predictive accuracy, calibration, or trading authority.

stages.name: ACTIVE_INFERENCE
stages.identity: Active Inference, object-centric generative vision and uncertainty resolution
stages.implementation_boundary: Object-centric world modelling, predictive coding, epistemic uncertainty, and active requests for a better crop, angle, zoom, or context are research architecture. They are not claimed as a completed runtime without separate implementation evidence.

stages.name: CURRENT_CANON
stages.identity: Visual-semantic cognition with human-AI fusion and competing intent hypotheses
stages.implementation_boundary: The Intent R26 contract, runtime, and benchmark harness exist. Sixty market cases are frozen; fifteen non-market cases and human-AI annotations remain missing, so calibration and uplift are not yet proven.

transitions.meaning: The semantic filter moved from assistive scenes to market charts as another noisy visual world.
Static semantic interpretation expanded into generative world modelling and active uncertainty reduction.
The research method was operationalized as falsifiable competing hypotheses and explicit human-AI revision.

claims_boundary: Lineage continuity does not prove production readiness.
Historical accessibility code remains preserved but does not control current module identity.
Active Inference remains a method claim until implementation evidence exists.
Intent contract validity does not prove calibration or human-AI uplift.
No stage grants trade, execution, capital, navigation, or safety-critical authority.
